qa.title: Frequently Asked Questions
qa.description: Find answers to common questions about Habit Tracker.
qa.q1.question: What is Habit Tracker?
qa.q1.answer: Habit Tracker is a free web application that helps you build and maintain positive daily habits. You can create habits, check in daily, track your streaks, and visualize your progress with charts and statistics.
qa.q2.question: How do I create a new habit?
qa.q2.answer: After logging in, go to the Dashboard and click the "Add habit" button. Give your habit a name and an optional description, then click "Create habit". You can also pick from our suggested habits to get started quickly.
qa.q3.question: Can I edit or delete a habit?
qa.q3.answer: Yes. Open the habit details page by clicking on a habit from your dashboard. From there you can edit the habit name and description, or delete the habit entirely.
qa.q4.question: How do streaks work?
qa.q4.answer: A streak counts the number of consecutive days you have checked in for a habit. If you miss a day, the streak resets to zero. Your best streak is saved so you can always try to beat your personal record.
qa.q5.question: How do I track my progress?
qa.q5.answer: Your dashboard shows an overview of your stats including total check-ins, current streaks, and a weekly activity chart. Each habit also has a detailed view with a calendar of check-ins and monthly breakdown charts.
qa.q6.question: Can I use Habit Tracker on mobile?
qa.q6.answer: Yes. Habit Tracker is fully responsive and works on phones, tablets, and desktops. The interface adapts automatically to your screen size.
qa.q7.question: Is my data secure?
qa.q7.answer: Your account is protected with JWT-based authentication. Passwords are securely hashed, and access tokens are stored in memory (not localStorage) to reduce the risk of XSS attacks. Refresh tokens are handled via httpOnly cookies.
qa.q8.question: Is Habit Tracker free to use?
qa.q8.answer: Yes, Habit Tracker is completely free and open-source. You can use all features without any payment or subscription.
help.title: Help
help.description: Learn how to use Habit Tracker and get the most out of your experience.
help.dashboard.title: Dashboard
help.dashboard.description: Your dashboard is the central hub for tracking your habits at a glance.
help.dashboard.step1: View your overall stats including total habits, check-ins, and best streak.
help.dashboard.step2: Check the weekly activity chart to see your recent progress.
help.dashboard.step3: See all your habits listed with their current streak and today's status.
help.dashboard.step4: Click on any habit to view its full details.
help.creatingHabit.title: Creating a Habit
help.creatingHabit.description: Start building new habits in just a few clicks.
help.creatingHabit.step1: Click "Add habit" in the sidebar or bottom navigation.
help.creatingHabit.step2: Pick a suggested habit from the quick start cards, or fill in the form manually.
help.creatingHabit.step3: Enter a name (required) and an optional description.
help.creatingHabit.step4: Click "Create habit" to save and start tracking.
help.trackingHabits.title: Tracking Habits
help.trackingHabits.description: Check in daily to build streaks and stay consistent.
help.trackingHabits.step1: From the dashboard, click the check-in button next to a habit.
help.trackingHabits.step2: Each consecutive day you check in increases your streak count.
help.trackingHabits.step3: Missing a day resets the streak to zero, but your best streak is always saved.
help.trackingHabits.step4: Try to maintain your streaks for long-term consistency.
help.habitDetails.title: Habit Details
help.habitDetails.description: Dive deeper into any habit to see your full history and stats.
help.habitDetails.step1: Click on a habit from the dashboard to open its detail page.
help.habitDetails.step2: View the calendar to see which days you checked in.
help.habitDetails.step3: Check the monthly breakdown charts for longer-term trends.
help.habitDetails.step4: Use the edit button to update the habit name or description, or delete it.
help.profile.title: Profile
help.profile.description: Manage your account settings and personal information.
help.profile.step1: Click "Profile" in the sidebar or bottom navigation.
help.profile.step2: Update your display name or other account details.
help.profile.step3: Change your password from the profile settings.
help.navigation.title: Navigation
help.navigation.description: Find your way around the app on any device.
help.navigation.step1: On desktop, use the sidebar on the left to switch between pages.
help.navigation.step2: On mobile, use the bottom navigation bar to access all sections.
help.navigation.step3: The Q&A page is available from both the sidebar and the guest header.
help.navigation.step4: Admins will see an additional "Admin" link for user management.
